title: Reliable change in autobiographical memory after electroconvulsive therapy: Depressed-control reference data and one-year follow-up
title_zh: 电休克治疗后自传记忆的可靠变化：抑郁对照参考数据与一年随访
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Columbia University Autobiographical Memory Interview-Short Form (AMI-SF) is commonly used in electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) research, but reference data are lacking for determining whether decline observed after ECT exceeds expected retest change. METHODS: Individual participant data from 99 depressed inpatients with no lifetime ECT exposure and 218 ECT recipients treated with right unilateral (RUL) or bitemporal (BT) ECT were analysed. Reliable decline was defined relative to depressed controls assessed over equivalent intervals using reliable change indices and standardised regression-based methods. RESULTS: In depressed controls, the mean percentage of baseline autobiographical information reproduced was 76.9% at end-of-treatment, 75.1% at 3 months, 68.4% at 6 months, and 65.5% at 12 months. At end-of-treatment, approximately three in ten RUL patients and one in two BT patients showed reliable decline. At 12 months, corresponding proportions were one in ten after RUL and three in ten after BT ECT. On average, lower proportions at later follow-ups did not indicate recovery of memories not recalled at end-of-treatment; mean scores in ECT groups remained broadly unchanged during long-term follow-up while controls declined further. CONCLUSIONS: Autobiographical memory decline exceeding that expected in depressed controls was common acutely after ECT and remained substantially more frequent after BT than RUL ECT at one year follow-up. After RUL ECT, nine in ten patients did not meet reliable decline criteria at one-year follow-up. These psychometric thresholds describe statistically unusual change, not necessarily clinically meaningful retrograde amnesia.
abstract_zh: 背景：哥伦比亚大学自传记忆访谈简短版（AMI‑SF）常用于电休克治疗（ECT）研究，但缺乏参考数据来判断ECT后观察到的下降是否超过预期的再测变化。方法：分析了99名无终身ECT史的抑郁住院患者与218名接受右侧单侧（RUL）或双侧颞叶（BT）ECT的患者的个体数据。可靠下降是相对于在等间隔内评估的抑郁对照组，使用可靠变化指数和标准化回归方法定义的。结果：在抑郁对照组中，基线自传信息的平均回忆比例为治疗结束时76.9%，3个月时75.1%，6个月时68.4%，12个月时65.5%。治疗结束时，约三分之一的RUL患者和一半的BT患者显示可靠下降。12个月时，RUL后对应比例为十分之一，BT后为十分之三。平均而言，后期随访比例较低并未表明治疗结束时未回忆的记忆得以恢复；ECT组的平均得分在长期随访期间基本保持不变，而对照组进一步下降。结论：ECT后急性期自传记忆下降超过抑郁对照组预期的情况很常见，并且在一年随访后BT ECT的频率仍显著高于RUL ECT。RUL ECT后，九成患者在一年随访时未达到可靠下降标准。这些心理测量阈值描述了统计学上不寻常的变化，而不一定代表临床意义上的逆行性健忘。
